tools.name: search_legislation
tools.description:
Search FULL BILL TEXT -- not just known-bill-number lookup. `q` is
    matched against titles, descriptions, AND ingested document text via
    Postgres websearch_to_tsquery (supports "quoted phrases", OR, and
    -exclusion, same syntax as a search engine), with a fuzzy pg_trgm
    title-similarity

tools.name: get_bill_record
tools.description:
Fetch the full record for one bill: metadata, sponsors, subjects,
    actions, versions, and vote-event summaries. Look up by canonical
    bill_id (UUID), or by jurisdiction + identifier (+ optional session to
    disambiguate).

tools.name: compare_bill_versions
tools.description:
Deterministic diff (unified + structured) between two versions of a
    bill's extracted text. Defaults to earliest vs. latest texted version if
    version ids are omitted. Errors if fewer than 2 versions have extracted
    text. Result is labeled 'derived' (computed by Bill Commons, not an
    off

tools.name: find_similar_bills
tools.description:
Find bills with similar titles via deterministic trigram similarity,
    across jurisdictions. Labeled 'derived' -- not an official
    cross-reference or companion-bill designation.

tools.name: get_vote_details
tools.description:
Fetch vote event(s) with member-level (yes/no/other/absent) vote
    records. Provide vote_event_id for one vote, or bill_id for all recorded
    votes on that bill.

tools.name: get_upcoming_hearings
tools.description:
List upcoming (future-dated) legislative hearings/events, optionally
    filtered by jurisdiction and/or bill.

tools.name: trace_legislative_history
tools.description:
Full chronological legislative history for a bill: merged timeline of
    actions, version publications, and votes, plus related-bill links.

tools.name: build_legislative_evidence_packet
tools.description:
Compile a citation-ready evidence packet for a bill: full official
    record, legislative history timeline, votes with member-level detail, and
    hearings -- each explicitly labeled official vs. derived with source URLs.

    Returns a `how_to_cite` block with a one-line `cite_as` sentence, a hum

tools.name: get_jurisdiction_coverage
tools.description:
Return the jurisdiction_coverage state-machine status for one state
    (abbreviation or name), or the full 51-jurisdiction coverage matrix if
    state is omitted.

tools.name: get_active_sessions
tools.description:
List legislative sessions currently flagged active, optionally
    filtered by jurisdiction (two-letter state code or name).

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description:
List Bill Commons' curated cross-state topic trackers (e.g. artificial
    intelligence, youth online safety, platform accountability,
    cybersecurity, cryptocurrency, data privacy, local government &
    preemption) -- the entry point for "what subjects does Bill Commons
    track across all 50 s

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_legislation" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Search bills by keyword/phrase (full-text) or normalized bill number
    (e.g. "HB 123", "H.B. 123", "hb123" all match). Optionally filter by
    jurisdiction (two-letter state code or name), chamber, and status." → after: "Search FULL BILL TEXT -- not just known-bill-number lookup. `q` is
    matched against titles, descriptions, AND ingested document text via
    Postgres websearch_to_tsquery (supports "quoted phrases", OR, and
    -exclusion, same syntax as a search engine), with a fuzzy pg_trgm
    title-similarity"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
